The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 7 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 7. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller.

bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 15. delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 24. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 26. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Sr Postmaster Guwahati GPO payable at Guwahati . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 27. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 29. DD should be made in favour of Sr Postmaster Guwahati GPO payable at

Guwahati . FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr Postmaster Guwahati GPO A/C (Name of the Seller). Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical/Eligibility Conditions for Supply of UPS (2 KVA, 3 KVA, 5 KVA & 10 KVA): 1. Valid Electrical Contractor's License: The bidder must possess valid Electrical Contractor’s Licence f or installation/commissioning of UPS in Assam. 2. OEM Certifications: The UPS OEM must possess valid ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, an d ISO/IEC 27001 certifications, along with valid RoHS compliance, CE marking, EPR authorization, and BIS r egistration/certification for the offered product category. Self-certified copies of all the above shall be furni shed along with the bid, verifiable from the respective certifying body's website. 3. Malicious Code / Security Certificate: A Malicious Code Certificate, duly signed by the OEM, certifyin g that the offered product/firmware is free from any malware, spyware, or malicious code, must be submit ted along with the bid. 4. Warranty Declaration: The OEM must furnish a signed Warranty Declaration Certificate guaranteeing a minimum warranty of 3 (three) years on the UPS unit and 2 (two) years on the battery, from the date of i nstallation/commissioning. 5. OEM Authorization Certificate: (a) The certificate must be bid-specific, explicitly mentioning the GeM Bid Number. (b) The certificate date must be on or after the bid publishing date. (c) The validity period of the authorization must be mentioned (d) It must be signed by an authorized signatory of the OEM on the OEM's letterhead. 6. Product Catalogue: The offered product's complete technical specifications must be available on the OEM's official website. The specific web link/URL to the product page must be furnished along with the bid for verification by the evaluation committee. 7. Toll-Free Customer Care: The OEM must have a functional Toll-Free Customer Care number or dedica ted service support numbre for technical support and complaint registration. Details (number, hours of ope ration, and email ID) must be furnished along with the bid. 8. Authorized Service Centres in Assam: (a) The OEM must have functional, OEM-authorized service centres in atleast 3(three) districts of Assam in cluding atleast one in the Southern Assam covering Dima Hasao and Cachar Districts. Service coverage sol ely through a third-party vendor/dealer, without direct OEM authorization, will not be considered sufficient. (b) Documentary proof (authorization letter naming the service centre, its address, and contact details) mu

st be furnished along with the bid. (c) The bidder must undertake to resolve any service complaint within 3 days from the date of registration of complaint, failing which penalty clauses as per GFR 2017 / GeM Contr act Terms shall apply. 9. After-Sales Support & Spares: The OEM/bidder must ensure availability of genuine spare parts and b atteries for the entire warranty period, and submit an undertaking that the spare parts will be available in market atleast for another 5 years after the warranty period. 10. Installation: Installation of the UPS shall be done at the respective locations (Post Offices) within 5 da ys of submitting request by the Consignee. It is to be noted here that the site of installation may be differe nt from the site of delivery. 11. Non-Compliance: Bids not accompanied by the above certificates/documents in the prescribed mann er shall be summarily rejected as non-responsive at the technical evaluation stage itself, without further re ference to the bidder. .
